description: Utility functions for handling MIME types, URLs, SVG elements, and canvas operations within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: parseExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a URL.

methods.name: mimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type based on file extension in URL.

methods.name: isDataUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a data URL.

methods.name: asBlob
methods.description: Converts a canvas to a PNG Blob.

methods.name: canvasToBlob
methods.description: Converts a canvas to a Blob, using toBlob if available.

methods.name: resolveUrl
methods.description: Resolves a relative URL against a base URL.

methods.name: dataAsUrl
methods.description: Creates a data URL from content and MIME type.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Converts an ArrayLike object to a standard array.

methods.name: escapeXhtml
methods.description: Escapes certain characters in a string for XHTML.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Calculates the width of an HTML element including borders.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Calculates the height of an HTML element including borders.

methods.name: isSVGElement
methods.description: Checks if an HTML element is an SVG element.
